company: Wattle Creek Medical Group Pty Ltd

roles.title: Chief Executive Officer
responsibilities: Leads the group and its management team.

roles.title: Clinical Director
responsibilities: Leads the clinicians and signs off on clinical equipment.

roles.title: General Practitioner
responsibilities: Sees patients and requests clinical equipment and supplies.

roles.title: Operations Manager
responsibilities: Runs the clinics, the rosters and purchasing, and approves the clinics' purchases.

roles.title: Practice Coordinator
responsibilities: Raises purchase requests and keeps each clinic stocked.

roles.title: Patient Services Manager
responsibilities: Leads reception and handles patient complaints.

roles.title: Receptionist
responsibilities: Books appointments, takes payments and logs refund requests.

roles.title: HR Advisor
responsibilities: Checks new clinicians' registration and prepares their contracts.

roles.title: Finance Manager
responsibilities: Owns budgets, payments and the group's accounts.

roles.title: Accounts Officer
responsibilities: Pays suppliers and processes patient refunds.

relationships.description: Practice Operations sends supplier invoices to Finance for matching and payment.

evidence.quote: Practice Operations sends each supplier invoice to Finance. The Accounts Officer matches it to the purchase order and pays the supplier within 30 days.

relationships.description: Patient Services sends approved refunds to Finance to be processed.

evidence.quote: Approved refunds go to Finance. The Accounts Officer refunds the patient's card within 5 business days.

relationships.description: People & Culture sends new clinician details to Clinical Services before the start date.

evidence.quote: When a clinician accepts an offer, the HR Advisor checks their registration and sends the new clinician's details to Clinical Services at least ten business days before the start date.

relationships.description: Clinical Services sends a roster request to Practice Operations to add the clinician to rosters and the booking system.

evidence.quote: The Clinical Director confirms the clinician's sessions and sends a roster request to Practice Operations, which adds the clinician to the clinic rosters and the booking system.
